angle_en: mamam kritva, by making it mine, reveals the secret of surrender
angle_hi: मामम कृत्वा, यानी सब कुछ मेरा करके, यह बताता है कि इस योग का रहस्य मेरे को सब कुछ सौंपना है।

en.intro: Krishna has just told Arjuna to offer every action and its fruits to the divine. Listen to how this offering changes his very being.
en.notice: The word mamam kritva, by making it mine, means that the secret of this yoga is to surrender your actions to me. This act of surrender is what frees you.
en.next: Krishna now reveals that this surrender leads to a direct communion with him, where he and the devotee dwell together.
en.meaning: In this way, you will be freed from the bonds of action and its results. Given over to renunciation-yoga, released, you will come to me.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी अर्जुन को हर कर्म और उसके फल को ईश्वर को अर्पित करने को कहा है। सुनिए, यह अर्पण अर्जुन की सत्ता को कैसे बदल देता है।
hi.meaning: इस प्रकार शुभ और अशुभ कर्मों के फलों से तू कर्मबन्धन से मुक्त हो जाएगा। तू अपने आप सहित सब कुछ मेरे अर्पण करके सभी बंधनों से मुक्त होकर मेरे पास आ जाएगा।
hi.notice: मामम कृत्वा, यानी सब कुछ मेरा करके, यह बताता है कि इस योग का रहस्य मेरे को सब कुछ सौंपना है। यही समर्पण तुझे मुक्त करता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब बताते हैं कि यह समर्पण सीधे उनके साथ मिलन की ओर ले जाता है, जहाँ वे और भक्त एक साथ निवास करते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna has just told Arjuna to offer every action and its fruits to the divine. Listen to how this offering changes his very being.
en.body: In this way, you will be freed from the bonds of action and its results. Given over to renunciation-yoga, released, you will come to me. The word mamam kritva, by making it mine, means that the secret of this yoga is to surrender your actions to me. This act of surrender is what frees you. Krishna now reveals that this surrender leads to a direct communion with him, where he and the devotee dwell together.

issues: meaning_changed: "जो अपने आप सहित सब कुछ मेरे अर्पण करता है और सभी बंधनों से मुक्त हो जाता है, वह मुझे प्राप्त हो जाएगा" (The English meaning and the source verse use the future tense 'you will come to me' (उपैष्यसि) directed at Arjuna. The Hindi translation shifts to a third-person general statement ('he who offers... will attain me'), dropping the direct address to Arjuna and changing the grammatical person.)
